description: Registry of MCP servers the security lab can install. Each entry is reviewed at setup time via configs/lab-mcp-consent.sh; nothing here is auto-registered.

mcps.name: AFL++ MCP
mcps.purpose: Drives AFL++ fuzzing from a coding agent (kicks off runs, parses crashes).
permissions: executes afl-fuzz and AFL++ helper binaries

mcps.name: Ghidra MCP
mcps.purpose: Lets a coding agent read Ghidra projects (function names, decompilation, cross-refs).
permissions: launches Ghidra and may modify the Ghidra user config directory
reads project files under any path the user grants
mcps.register_command: codex mcp add ghidra -- python3 -m tools.setup deploy --ghidra-path '<path-to-ghidra>'
